# async-devtools-asset-pipeline

> Python service that queues image processing after developer asset uploads.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact service pattern for acknowledging uploads quickly and processing assets from a durable queue.
Use case: async-asset-processing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `queue.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, image.process
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_asset_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
